span.p:
Compliance mapping, printed on the cover
SOC 2 CC9.2 · ISO 27001 A.5.19 to A.5.23
DORA ICT third-party register
NIS2 Article 21 2 d supply chain
one line that reframes the artefact from
logs to the thing your auditor asks for

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why it is templated
a model-written binder could be steered by the very payload
the binder exists to report. Spans carry refs, hashes and
enumerated verdicts — never raw external content.
